narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On June 19, 2024, at approximately 1020 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] assisted the Wood County Sheriff's Office near Perrysburg, Ohio, with a man detained after a traffic violation. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] interviewed the subject, who stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and has no documents allowing him to remain in the United States. He presented a Mexican voter identification card.
IMMIGRATION HISTORY:
Fingerprint checks of the subject returned no prior immigration history.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he entered the United States without inspection near Douglas, Arizona, in March 2020, walking through the desert.
TRAVEL:
He was driven from Arizona to Ohio in 2020.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was placed in removal proceedings and served a Notice to Appear. He will be held pending removal proceedings and may be removed if ordered by an immigration judge.
